title: Norml CI/CD
pitch: Choose and document how a WordPress project deploys, protects live data and recovers from failure.
problem: A code deploy, a database promotion and a media sync can affect very different state. Treating them as one operation can overwrite live work.
This package records topology, data ownership, backups, permissions and exact verification before another operator ships.
commands: Set up CI/CD for this WordPress project
Create a theme-only local workspace contract
Set up the backup and restore strategy
Put this project in MVP mode

flow.d: Verify repository, environments and current authority.
Choose deployment, database and backup strategies.
Fill the project contract with exact supported commands.
Resolve target, recovery and permission blockers.

items.name: Four data strategies
items.desc: Live ownership, initial replacement and scoped migration.

items.name: Backup and MVP policy
items.desc: Recovery evidence and an explicit delivery-mode overlay.

items.name: Execute deployment
items.desc: This package prepares policy; it does not deploy.

items: No deployment execution or credentials issuance.
Provider APIs, plan entitlements and commands must be verified for the target.
Selecting a pattern grants no production or destructive-data authority.
